content: Drop by drop, the great earthen jar is filled to overflowing.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
explanation: An empty clay amphora looks dauntingly dry at first drop. But if a steady spring drips into the neck hour after hour, by evening the jar is filled with sweet, cool water. Do not despise the single droplet of daily effort, daily reading, or daily kindness.
practicalInsight: Deposit your droplet today: write one page, save five dollars, or practice five minutes of quiet meditation.
reflectionPrompt: What reservoir in your life are you neglecting because you think a single drop doesn't matter?
